name: jev-skill-router
description: Route Codex skills with TypeSafe Jev and inspect local selection history in a web dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Jev skill routing with local selection analytics.
interface.longDescription: Selects relevant skills with TypeSafe Jev, records decisions locally, and starts a bilingual web dashboard when Codex opens using the included macOS startup helper, with task and message hooks as a fallback. Inspect selection rates, trends, and routing history. Explicit skill requests and existing permissions remain authoritative.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure Jev Skill Router.
